create_profile: create an isolated hermes profile with its own config, skills, and gateway
delete_profile: delete a hermes profile, its wrapper alias, and stop its gateway service
export_profile: export a hermes profile to a tar.gz archive excluding credentials and runtime state
import_profile: import a hermes profile from a tar.gz archive into the profiles directory
rename_profile: rename a hermes profile directory, wrapper script, and update active profile
